data.title: Sacked ALDI worker's use of AI as 'quasi-legal advisor' condemned
data.description: The Fair Work Commission will soon require applicants to disclose any AI use with consequences for failing to be transparent.
data.keywords: artificial intelligence, AI, Fair Work Commission, Canberra, ACT, legal advice, Sadnan Khan, Michael Easton, Gregory Baker, Macquarie University, ALDI
